cases.ancestry_or_population: Japanese founder (87% of FCMD chromosomes; carrier frequency 6/676)
cases.mechanism_detail: Founder 3-kb retrotransposal insertion in the 3'UTR of FCMD; this paper describes a PCR diagnostic assay and does not investigate the mechanism or name the element class in the abstract. 16+3 homozygotes and 2 heterozygotes detected.
cases.quote: In Japan, most FCMD-bearing chromosomes (87%) have a 3-kb retrotransposal insertion into the 3'-untranslated region (UTR) of the gene that could be derived from a single ancestral founder.
